S(f, x) = { ∞ if |m| ≤ 0
            A (‖J‖² + ‖J⁻¹‖²) otherwise 
where f ∈ F, x_i ∈ ℝ²,

n = (x̄_b-x̄_a)×(x̄_c-x̄_a),

            A (‖J‖² + ‖J⁻¹‖²) otherwise 
where f ∈ F, x_i ∈ ℝ²,
a, b, c = OrientedVertices(f),

"""
import jax.numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M, x̄, x, ε, psd):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
        x̄ = np.asarray(x̄, dtype=np.float64)
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = x̄.shape[0]
        assert x̄.shape == (dim_0, 3, )
        assert x.shape == (dim_0, 2, )
        assert np.ndim(ε) == 0

        self.M = M
        self.x̄ = x̄
        self.x = x
        _Neighborhoods = self.Neighborhoods(M)
        self.NeighborVerticesInFace = _Neighborhoods.NeighborVerticesInFace
        self.Faces = _Neighborhoods.Faces
        self.Faces_0 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_0
        self.Faces_1 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_1
        self.VertexOneRing = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing
        self.VertexOneRing_0 = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing_0
        self.OrientedVertices = _Neighborhoods.OrientedVertices
        self.OrientedVertices_0 = _Neighborhoods.OrientedVertices_0
        # e = ∑_(i ∈ F) S_i(x)
        sum_0 = 0
        for i in self.F:
            sum_0 += self.S(i, x)
        self.e = sum_0
        # H = ∑_(i ∈ F) psd(∂²S_i(x)/∂x²)
        sum_1 = np.zeros((2*dim_0, 2*dim_0))
        for i in self.F:
            sum_1 += psd(jax.hessian(self.S(i, x))(x))
        self.H = sum_1
        # G = ∂e/∂x
        self.G = 

    def m_r(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        m_r_0 = np.hstack(((br - ar).reshape(2, 1), (cr - ar).reshape(2, 1)))
        rhs_1 = self.OrientedVertices(f)
        a = rhs_1[0]
        b = rhs_1[1]
        c = rhs_1[2]

        # n = (x̄_b-x̄_a)×(x̄_c-x̄_a)
        n = np.cross((self.x̄[b] - self.x̄[a]), (self.x̄[c] - self.x̄[a]))

        # b1 = (x̄_b-x̄_a)/‖x̄_b-x̄_a‖
        b1 = ((self.x̄[b] - self.x̄[a])) / (np.linalg.norm(self.x̄[b] - self.x̄[a], 2))

        # b2 = (n × b1)/‖n × b1‖
        b2 = ((np.cross(n, b1))) / (np.linalg.norm(np.cross(n, b1), 2))

        # ar = (0, 0)
        ar = np.hstack((0, 0))

        # br = ((x̄_b-x̄_a)⋅b1, 0)
        br = np.hstack((np.dot(((self.x̄[b] - self.x̄[a])).ravel(), (b1).ravel()), 0))

        # cr = ((x̄_c-x̄_a)⋅b1, (x̄_c-x̄_a)⋅b2)
        cr = np.hstack((np.dot(((self.x̄[c] - self.x̄[a])).ravel(), (b1).ravel()), np.dot(((self.x̄[c] - self.x̄[a])).ravel(), (b2).ravel())))
        return m_r_0

    def S(self, f, x):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_1 = x.shape[0]
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert x.shape == (dim_1, 2, )
        assert f in self.F

        if scipy.linalg.det(m) <= 0:
            S_ret = np.inf
        else:
            S_ret = A * (np.power(np.asarray(np.linalg.norm(J, 'fro'), dtype=np.float64), 2) + np.power(np.asarray(np.linalg.norm(np.linalg.inv(J), 'fro'), dtype=np.float64), 2))
        rhs_2 = self.OrientedVertices(f)
        a = rhs_2[0]
        b = rhs_2[1]
        c = rhs_2[2]

        # m = [x_b-x_a x_c-x_a]
        m_0 = np.hstack(((x[b] - x[a]).reshape(2, 1), (x[c] - x[a]).reshape(2, 1)))
        m = m_0

        # A = ½ |`m_r`(f)|
        A = (1/2) * scipy.linalg.det(self.m_r(f))

        # J = m `m_r`(f)⁻¹
        J = m @ np.linalg.inv(self.m_r(f))
        return S_ret
    class Neighborhoods:
        def __init__(self, M):
            rhs = M.ElementSets()
            self.V = rhs[0]
            self.E = rhs[1]
            self.F = rhs[2]
            dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
            dime_0 = M.n_edges()
            dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
            self.M = M
            _FundamentalMeshAccessors = self.FundamentalMeshAccessors(M)
            self.Vertices = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices
            self.Vertices_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_0
            self.Vertices_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_1
            self.Vertices_2 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_2
            self.Vertices_3 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Vertices_3
            self.Edges = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges
            self.Edges_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges_0
            self.Edges_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Edges_1
            self.Faces = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces
            self.Faces_0 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces_0
            self.Faces_1 = _FundamentalMeshAccessors.Faces_1
            rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
            self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
            self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
            rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
            self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
            self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
            # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
            self.B0T = self.B0.T
            # `B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
            self.B1T = self.B1.T
        def VertexOneRing(self, v):
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))) - {v}
        def VertexOneRing_0(self, v):
            v = frozenset(v)
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator(v, self.M.n_vertices()))) - v
        def EdgeIndex(self, i, j):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            # eset = Edges(i) ∩ Edges(j)
            eset = frozenset.intersection(self.Edges_0(i), self.Edges_0(j))
            return list(eset)[1-1]
        def NeighborVerticesInFace(self, f, v):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            assert f in self.F
            # es = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂¹` IndicatorVector({f})))
            es = nonzeros(self.dee1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))
            # nes = { s for s ∈ es if `∂⁰`_v,s != 0 }
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1 = set()
            range = es
            for s in range:
                if(self.dee0.tocsr()[v, s] != 0):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1.add(s)
            nes = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1
            # eset1 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2 = set()
            range_1 = nes
            for e in range_1:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2.add(e)
            eset1 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2
            # vset1 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset1))) - {v}
            vset1 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset1, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
            # eset2 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = 1 }
            NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4 = set()
            range_2 = nes
            for e in range_2:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == 1):
                    NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4.add(e)
            eset2 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4
            # vset2 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset2))) - {v}
            vset2 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset2, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
            return [list(vset1)[1-1],list(vset2)[1-1]]
        def NextVerticeInFace(self, f, v):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            assert f in self.F
            # eset = { e for e ∈ Edges(f) if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
            NextVerticeInFaceset_0 = set()
            range_3 = self.Edges_1(f)
            for e in range_3:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                    NextVerticeInFaceset_0.add(e)
            eset = NextVerticeInFaceset_0
            # vset = Vertices(eset) - {v}
            vset = self.Vertices_3(eset) - {v}
            return list(vset)[1-1]
        def OrientedVertices(self, f):
            assert np.ndim(f) == 0
            assert f in self.F
            # vs = Vertices(f)
            vs = self.Vertices_0(f)
            rhs_3 = self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, list(vs)[1-1])
            i = rhs_3[0]
            j = rhs_3[1]
            return [list(vs)[1-1],i,j]
        def Diamond(self, e):
            assert np.ndim(e) == 0
            assert e in self.E
            return [self.Vertices_2(e),{e},self.Faces_1(e),[]]
        def OrientedOppositeFaces(self, i, j):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            # e = EdgeIndex(i, j)
            e = self.EdgeIndex(i, j)
            # fset = Faces(e)
            fset = self.Faces_1(e)
            # firf = { f for f ∈ fset if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_i,e = -1 }
            OrientedOppositeFacesset_0 = set()
            range_4 = fset
            for f in range_4:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[i, e] == -1):
                    OrientedOppositeFacesset_0.add(f)
            firf = OrientedOppositeFacesset_0
            # secf = fset - firf
            secf = fset - firf
            return [list(firf)[1-1],list(secf)[1-1]]
        def OppositeFaces(self, e):
            assert np.ndim(e) == 0
            assert e in self.E
            # fset = Faces(e)
            fset = self.Faces_1(e)
            # firf = { f for f ∈ fset if `∂¹`_e,f = 1 }
            OppositeFacesset_0 = set()
            range_5 = fset
            for f in range_5:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] == 1):
                    OppositeFacesset_0.add(f)
            firf = OppositeFacesset_0
            # secf = { f for f ∈ fset if `∂¹`_e,f = -1 }
            OppositeFacesset_1 = set()
            range_6 = fset
            for f in range_6:
                if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] == -1):
                    OppositeFacesset_1.add(f)
            secf = OppositeFacesset_1
            return [list(firf)[1-1],list(secf)[1-1]]
        def OppositeVertices(self, e):
            assert np.ndim(e) == 0
            assert e in self.E
            rhs_4 = self.OppositeFaces(e)
            firf = rhs_4[0]
            secf = rhs_4[1]
            # firv = Vertices(firf) \ Vertices(e)
            firv = self.Vertices_0(firf) - self.Vertices_2(e)
            # secv = Vertices(secf) \ Vertices(e)
            secv = self.Vertices_0(secf) - self.Vertices_2(e)
            return [list(firv)[1-1],list(secv)[1-1]]
        def OppositeVertices_0(self, i, j):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            rhs_5 = self.OrientedOppositeFaces(i, j)
            firf = rhs_5[0]
            secf = rhs_5[1]
            # firv = Vertices(firf) \ {i, j}
            firv = self.Vertices_0(firf) - {i, j}
            # secv = Vertices(secf) \ {i, j}
            secv = self.Vertices_0(secf) - {i, j}
            return [list(firv)[1-1],list(secv)[1-1]]
        def FaceIndex(self, i, j, k):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert np.ndim(k) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            assert k in self.V
            # ufv = `B¹`ᵀ `B⁰`ᵀ
            ufv = self.B1.T @ self.B0.T
            # iface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({i})))
            iface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({i}, self.M.n_vertices()))
            # jface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({j})))
            jface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({j}, self.M.n_vertices()))
            # kface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv IndicatorVector({k})))
            kface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({k}, self.M.n_vertices()))
            # fset = iface ∩ jface ∩ kface
            fset = frozenset.intersection(iface, frozenset.intersection(jface, kface))
            return list(fset)[1-1]
        def OrientedVertices_0(self, i, j, k):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert np.ndim(k) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            assert k in self.V
            # f = FaceIndex(i, j, k)
            f = self.FaceIndex(i, j, k)
            return self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, i)
        class FundamentalMeshAccessors:
            def __init__(self, M):
                rhs = M.ElementSets()
                self.V = rhs[0]
                self.E = rhs[1]
                self.F = rhs[2]
                dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
                dime_0 = M.n_edges()
                dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
                self.M = M
                rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
                self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
                self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
                rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
                self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
                self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
                # B0T = B0ᵀ
                self.B0T = self.B0.T
                # B1T = B1ᵀ
                self.B1T = self.B1.T
            def Vertices(self, S):
                return S[1-1]
            def Edges(self, S):
                return S[2-1]
            def Faces(self, S):
                return S[3-1]
            def Vertices_0(self, f):
                assert np.ndim(f) == 0
                assert f in self.F
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces())))
            def Vertices_1(self, G):
                G = frozenset(G)
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B1 @ indicator(G, self.M.n_faces())))
            def Vertices_2(self, e):
                assert np.ndim(e) == 0
                assert e in self.E
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))
            def Vertices_3(self, H):
                H = frozenset(H)
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(H, self.M.n_edges()))
            def Edges_0(self, v):
                assert np.ndim(v) == 0
                assert v in self.V
                return nonzeros(self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))
            def Edges_1(self, f):
                assert np.ndim(f) == 0
                assert f in self.F
                return nonzeros(self.B1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))
            def Faces_0(self, v):
                assert np.ndim(v) == 0
                assert v in self.V
                return nonzeros(self.B1T @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices())))
            def Faces_1(self, e):
                assert np.ndim(e) == 0
                assert e in self.E
                return nonzeros(self.B1T @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))
